translation: The Belt Vessel (Daimai). It arises at the Zhangmen point of the foot Absolute Yin (Liver) at the floating rib, and together with the foot Lesser Yang (Gallbladder) follows the Daimai point (Zhangmen is the meeting of the foot Absolute Yin and Lesser Yang, located at the end of the floating rib bone, where the tip of the elbow ends is the point. The Daimai point belongs to the foot Lesser Yang channel, located in the depression one cun and eight fen below the floating rib). It encircles the body once, like a belt. It also meets the foot Lesser Yang at Wushu (three cun below the Belt Vessel) and Weidao (five cun and three fen below Zhangmen), altogether eight points.
